note: City of Jarrell, Williamson County, TX. INSTRUMENT: Unified Development Code Chapter 4.00 (Zoning District Use Regulations and Lot Design Standards), Sec. 4.11.03.E, Table 4-11 (Lot Design Standards). Amendment history for Table 4-11 ends at Ordinance 2024-0206-01 adopted 2/6/2024 (effectiveDate). SOURCE (OFFICIAL, re-verified 2026-11-12): the City's eCode360 publication JA6361, as two downloads dated 2026-11-11: the full code as HTML (sha256 26618dead18213dea19d703b0bf2767b2ed688cca959d96255c26368ed8cb16d) and the Unified Development Code as PDF (sha256 dabf1af33e5189a3f4db8ccc722d051a274d0023ae36c50e03d0ddaacd1ad406). Table 4-11 reads identically in both. This replaces the earlier third-party mirror transcription; every value is unchanged, 75 of 75 matched, so only provenance and confidence changed. SCOPE: Table 4-11 is a city-limit table. Sec. 4.11.02.A makes these standards non-binding guidelines in the ETJ until land is annexed and zoned. ROWS: 15, the Table 4-11 columns. Sec. 4.05 / Table 4-1 lists 16 base districts (these 15 plus PUD) and 3 overlays (I-35, DT, OT) that Sec. 4.08.02 marks Reserved, with no standards. ADJACENCY: Table 4-11 has Min. Rear and Min. Side Setback Adjacent to Residential rows for MH, C-1, C-2, C-3, MU, BP, I-1, I-2 and PF; the schema has no field for them, so the general minimum is coded in rear_ft / side_ft and the adjacency figure is carried in that field's provenance quote. Min. lot area, min. lot width and max. density are likewise in Table 4-11 but have no schema field and are not coded. COVERAGE: Table 4-11 and the rest of the code state no lot-coverage or impervious-cover percentage, so max_lot_coverage_pct and max_impervious_pct are not_specified with the 100 sentinel. PUD: no row, by design. Planned Unit Development (Sec. 4.08.01.D) takes its setbacks, height and lot standards from its own PUD ordinance and General Development Plan (Sec. 3.07.05), so a PUD parcel routes to the PUD refusal (needs the PUD ordinance), not to this table. Where a PUD ordinance is silent, Sec. 3.07.05.F falls back to the Code's subdivision requirements and the most restrictive standard district permitting the uses. ZEROS: zero setbacks are real zeros in Table 4-11 (SF-3 side 0, C-1 and C-2 rear 0). Section numbers and values only; no code text is stored.
